covenants.name: Tangible Net Worth
covenants.quote: Maintain at all times Tangible Net Worth of not less than $20,000,000.

covenants.name: Liquidity
covenants.quote: Maintain at all times Liquidity of not less than $10,000,000.

covenants.name: Debt-to-Tangible Net Worth Ratio
covenants.quote: Maintain at all times a Debt to Tangible Net Worth Ratio of not more than 12:1.

covenants.name: Adjusted Net Income
covenants.quote: Maintain, as of the end of each calendar month, for the twelve months then ending, Adjusted Net Income of not less than $1.00.

parsed.notes: Financial covenants sit in Section 5.9 and are tested against Adjusted Net Income, Tangible Net Worth, Liquidity and Adjusted Total Liabilities as defined in Section 1.1. The agreement has no EBITDA definition, so no EBITDA add-backs apply. The Adjusted Net Income test is measured monthly on a trailing twelve-month basis. Section 10.11(b)(2) lets the Agent subordinate its liens to permitted lienholders without lender vote. Section 10.11(b)(3) and Section 11.10(c)(2) release a guarantor when all its equity is sold to a third party in a permitted disposition. The agreement is an amended and restated mortgage warehouse agreement that supersedes a prior agreement dated May 27, 2022.
parsed.facility: Mortgage warehouse revolving credit facility (Comerica Bank as Agent; Huntington and Truist as lenders): commitment of $275,000,000 during the First Step-Up Period (September 18 to November 10), $300,000,000 during the Second Step-Up Period (November 11 to February 9), and $200,000,000 otherwise; $50,000,000 swing line; revolving credit maturity May 24, 2024.

terms.summary: The agreement has no ban on moving intellectual property to unrestricted subsidiaries and no unrestricted subsidiary designation concept.

terms.quote: no amendment, waiver or consent shall, unless in writing and signed by the Lender or Lenders affected thereby, do any of the following
terms.summary: Releasing all or substantially all Collateral, and reducing principal or interest or postponing payments, require each affected lender's signature. The agreement does not expressly require affected-lender consent to subordinate loans or liens to other debt, and Section 10.11(b)(2) lets the Agent subordinate its liens to permitted lienholders.

terms.quote: if all of the Equity Interests held by the Credit Parties in any Person are sold or otherwise transferred to any transferee other than Borrower or a Subsidiary of Borrower
terms.summary: A guarantor is released only when all of its equity is sold to a third party in a permitted disposition, not merely because it stops being wholly owned. There is no express anti-release language.
The agreement has no unrestricted subsidiary concept. Investments in Subsidiaries under Section 6.7(g) are not capped.
No EBITDA add-backs for projected cost savings, synergies or restructuring appear; the only earnings measure is Adjusted Net Income, which has no such add-backs.
The agreement contains no right to cure a financial covenant default with new equity.
